rv.q: This is a show that's pure fun, blasting a sound worthy of turning up to 11.
This is a glorious production. It's filled with color, sparkle, verve and vitality.
Mercury Theater's Rock of Ages is totally bad-ass... Rock of Ages is a night you won't forget.
Miss it, and you miss one of the silliest, rockingest, and just plain fun shows of the year.
All in all, this is a highly energetic, vividly realized and decidedly uncensored show that thrives in the Mercury's intimate space.
If you're in the mood for a raunchy rock concert but want to get to bed at a decent time, then check out 'Rock of Ages.'
From start to finish, the audience was swept into the magic created on stage.

cn.t: Critics praise this high-energy 80s jukebox musical as wildly entertaining fun, packed with rock anthems and big-haired camp. The silly plot takes a backseat to excellent singing and infectious enthusiasm that gets audiences rocking.
